dashboardQueries.query:
metadata.vendor_name="Corelight"
metadata.product_event_type= /^conn/
$service=about.labels["service"]
$service!=""
$service!="ssl" AND $service!="tls" AND $service!="ssl,http" AND $service!="http,ssl" AND $service!="ssh" AND $service!="https" AND $service!="dtls" AND $service!="ssl,xmpp" AND $service!="spicy_ipsec_ike_udp" AND $service!="spicy_ipsec_udp" AND $service!="spicy_ipsec_ike_udp,spicy_ipsec_udp" AND $service!="spicy_stun_tcp" AND $service!="krb,krb_tcp"
$date_hour=timestamp.get_timestamp(metadata.event_timestamp.seconds, "%Y-%m-%d : %H")
match:
    $date_hour, $service
outcome:
    $unencrypted_traffic_volume=count_distinct(metadata.id)
order:
    $date_hour asc
